spec_match.rationale: Mirrors WPT audioworklet-messageport: port is a MessagePort before addModule(), module posts during evaluation, echo round-trip; plus the spec's close() note.

interactive.rationale: Context-type radios, create/load button, free-text echo and close() buttons all drive real API calls; log and status update live.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index card promise matches the page.

edge_cases.rationale: Covers close() (no reply afterwards) and both AudioContext and OfflineAudioContext; unsupported branch reports audioWorklet.port === undefined honestly.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus 5079784523694080 and the Web Audio spec anchors for AudioWorklet.port / AudioWorkletGlobalScope.port.

conformance.rationale: Feature-level suite asserts attribute, readonly accessor, pre-addModule MessagePort, identity, per-context distinctness, strict-mode throw, global-scope port and the module-evaluation + echo round-trip; all 8 fail on Chrome 153, so every probe can return false.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome 153 via Playwright at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3: every control clicked/tapped, status text changed, zero console errors and zero failed requests; screenshots read. Spec path NOT executable here (feature absent in 153).

telemetry_health.rationale: Asserts handshake-module-evaluation (spec vs unsupported branch labelled) and handshake-echo (expects no reply after close).

design_system.rationale: Only design-system variables (stone/ivory/paper backgrounds, emerald-dark/rose/muted verdict text); global button colours untouched.

accessibility.rationale: Native radios in a fieldset/legend, labelled text input, native buttons, one polite status, ordered log with aria-label.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: No horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3 or 1280x800; wide tables/code scroll inside labelled regions; 44px targets; both classes screenshot-verified.

openQuestions.title: Verify the spec path on Chrome 160 / Firefox 138+
openQuestions.detail: Only Chrome for Testing 153 was available here; AudioWorklet.prototype.port is absent there even with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features and --enable-blink-features=AudioWorkletSharedPort, so only the unsupported/bootstrap branch executed. Re-run every control on Chrome 160+ and record the spec-path outcome.

openQuestions.title: Inspect the accessibility tree with chrome-devtools-mcp
openQuestions.detail: chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this environment (project rule 7b); verification used headless Chrome via Playwright and screenshots only.

guidanceConsulted.query: live region status updates for async operation results
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use a single polite status region per result area; avoid announcing interstitial loading states.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: One role=status/aria-live=polite line per stage reports only final outcomes; logs/tables are plain content.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow on mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use wrapping flex/grid with min-inline-size:0 and contain wide tables/code in scroll containers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Controls use flex-wrap; tables sit in a focusable role=region scroll wrapper; pre blocks scroll internally.
guidanceConsulted.evidence: scrollWidth === innerWidth at 360x740 DPR3 and 1280x800 (Playwright headless Chrome 153).

guidanceConsulted.query: target size for buttons and form controls
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Targets at least 24x24 CSS px (2.5.8); bump up for coarse pointers.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: All buttons/selects/ranges/text inputs/radio labels have min-height 44px; verified no control under 44px tall.

summary: Canonical handshake; unsupported branch verified on Chrome 153 (port undefined, no global-scope message). Spec path awaits Chrome 160.
